text: Solicitation Issued: July 25, 2024 Solicitation Closed: September 16, 2024 Number of Addenda Issued: Four (4) Number of Bids: Two (2) Table 2: Summary of Bids Received Supplier Names Parsons Inc. * Stantec Consulting Ltd. *Pursuant to the Request for Proposal document, the contract award value includes contingency.

The Bid Award Panel adopted the following: 1. Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (November 21, 2024) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Proposal Document Number 4650772999, Contract RFP-24ECS-RD-01SP Description: Provision of Professional Engineering Services for the Preliminary Design, Detailed Design, Contract Administration and Post Construction for The North York Centre South Service Road (Doris Avenue) Infrastructure Improvements Recommended Supplier: Parsons Inc. Contract Award Value: $2,845,735 net of all applicable taxes and charges $3,215,681 including HST and all applicable charges $2,895,820 net of HST recoveries Contract is expected to start on date of award and end on July 31, 2029.
